title: Receipt scanner (close to an existing item)
text: Sorts a stack of 400 scanned shop receipts into expense categories and produces a spreadsheet for the accountant.

title: Garden irrigation planner
text: Reads soil-moisture sensor logs and a seven-day forecast, rewrites a vegetable garden's watering schedule, and texts the family when a bed needs hand watering.

title: Whale song translator
text: Aligns hydrophone recordings of humpback whale song with tagged behavior video to build a dictionary of repeated phrases.
